name: Loner (d20pfsrd)
body:
You do not have the ability to summon or gain a familiar or animal companion.

Prerequisite: Ability to summon a familiar or animal companion.

Effect: You are never able to summon a familiar or gain an animal companion through any means. Multi-
classing does not negate this flaw.
